name: VELESTO
recent: Velesto 获得 PETRONAS Carigali 的钻井合约，将部署 NAGA 3 钻机；同时宣布每股 2.00 仙的特别股息。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收和净利同比大幅下滑。
notable: 获得 PETRONAS Carigali 合约，部署 NAGA 3 钻机。
宣布每股 2.00 仙的特别股息。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 154,029,000 令吉，环比下降 16.0%，同比下降 23.0%；净利为 531,000 令吉，环比下降 98.1%，同比下降 98.9%；净利率为 0.3%，低于上一季度的 15.2%。

recent_en: Velesto secured a drilling contract from PETRONAS Carigali for the NAGA 3 rig and declared a special dividend of 2.00 sen per share. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw significant year-on-year declines in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Secured a contract from PETRONAS Carigali to deploy the NAGA 3 rig.
Declared a special dividend of 2.00 sen per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 154,029,000, down 16.0% QoQ and 23.0% YoY; net income was MYR 531,000, down 98.1% QoQ and 98.9% YoY; net margin was 0.3%, down from 15.2% in the previous quarter.
